note: End-to-end, cross-persona flows. Each step names the acting persona, the entity touched, and the resulting state. These are the backbone scenarios the product must support end-to-end.

journeys.name: Request access → fulfillment
journeys.trigger: An end user needs access to an application/entitlement/role.

steps.action: Browse catalog, add items to cart, add justification, submit
Run policy checks (SoD, risk), route via workflow/approval policy
Review with risk/context, approve or reject (possibly multi-step)
Provision to target app (simulated)
Confirm grant, notify requester, write audit event

journeys.name: Access certification campaign
journeys.trigger: A scheduled or ad-hoc review of who has what access.

steps.action: Define scope, type, reviewers, due date; launch
Work reviewer inbox: certify/revoke/delegate each item (bulk supported)
Revocations trigger deprovisioning; track progress
On completion, generate evidence; close campaign
Inspect/export campaign evidence

journeys.name: Joiner — birthright provisioning
journeys.trigger: HR event: a new identity joins.

steps.action: Detect joiner event from HR (simulated)
Evaluate birthright policy (department/title → roles)
Provision birthright access; flag exceptions for manager
Complete event; write audit evidence
Detect mover event; compute access delta (add/remove)
Review proposed changes; confirm removals of old access
Apply grants/revocations; complete
Detect leaver; set identity leaver-pending
Revoke all access; disable accounts (simulated)
Confirm full deprovisioning; terminate identity; evidence

journeys.name: SoD violation remediation
journeys.trigger: A conflicting access combination is detected.

steps.action: Detect violation against active SoD policy
Acknowledge; choose remediation (remove access) or grant exception with justification
Apply remediation; resolve

keyUX: violation detail with both conflicting sides

journeys.name: Emergency (break-glass) access
journeys.trigger: Urgent need for temporary elevated access.

steps.action: Request emergency access with reason
Grant time-bound access; start countdown
Auto-expire at window end
Mandatory post-use review of actions taken

journeys.name: Role definition & assignment
journeys.trigger: A role owner defines or updates a role.

steps.action: Define role: name, owner, bundle entitlements (draft)
Review SoD/risk impact of bundle; activate
Request the role (enters request-to-fulfillment)
